name: Goldfish Kaseem + Spin The Skull
description: Dive into the alternative scene at Maus Hábitos with a double bill promising eclectic sounds and a vibrant atmosphere.
longDescription:
On May 21, 2026, Maus Hábitos hosts a double bill featuring Goldfish Kaseem and Spin The Skull. Goldfish Kaseem is known for their experimental approach to music, often incorporating diverse genres and unconventional structures into their compositions. Spin The Skull, on the other hand, presents a sound characterized by its rhythmic complexity and atmospheric textures, drawing from post-rock and electronic influences. This event offers an evening of contemporary music from two distinct acts within the alternative scene.

Attendees can expect an evening of live music in the industrial-chic setting of Maus Hábitos, a venue known for its artistic programming and panoramic city views. The atmosphere is typically relaxed and conducive to discovery, attracting an audience interested in independent and experimental sounds. The event is scheduled for an evening slot, providing several hours of performances from both artists.

Tickets for this music event are priced at €8.00. Maus Hábitos is located in the heart of Porto, easily accessible by public transport. It is a short walk from São Bento train station and various bus stops, making it convenient for those arriving from different parts of the city.
